subject: Confirmation: No ML tuning on customer data — post-demo follow-up
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay.kapoor@orbithealth.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@medsys.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmation: No ML tuning on customer data — post-demo follow-up

Hi Sanjay / Elena,

Thanks again for the demo today — great discussion. Per our call, you asked for a formal confirmation that Orbit Health data will not be used to tune or improve any public or internal Redwood models. I wanted to capture the ask and next steps so we have alignment.

Summary of request (from the call):
- No training or model tuning on customer data (including logs) for any Redwood public or internal models.
- PII handling: fields classified as PHI/PII must be redacted or tokenized prior to any downstream processing beyond the serving runtime.
- Retention & logging: clearly documented retention windows and an auditable option for your security team.
- Data residency: customer prefers US-only hosting for this workload.

Next steps we proposed on the call:
1) I’ll circulate a Mutual Actions Plan (MAP) with the opt-out language and retention metrics for signature.
2) Aditya will confirm the exact logging retention and what can be provided as audit evidence (log extracts, access logs).
3) We’ll provide a short security controls summary (attachment) and confirm region pinning for this environment.

If that looks right I’ll get the MAP drafted and loop in Dylan (our privacy lead) for review on the retention and PII controls.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-09-21T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmation: No ML tuning on customer data — post-demo follow-up

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming Orbit Health requests explicitly: no training or model improvement using any of our customer data (including logs, telemetry, or derived features) at any time. We also require:
- Retention: access logs and request/response logs to be retained no longer than 30 days unless explicitly requested for an audit.
- Auditability: ability to provide time-bounded log extracts and record of who accessed data (audit trail) on a per-request basis.
- Residency: US-only region for any processing and storage tied to this account.

Quick question for your team: can Redwood provide an auditable statement that masking/redaction will be applied to PII before any non-serving analysis? If not, we’ll need a clause that prohibits such processing unless we opt in in writing.

Appreciate you moving the MAP — if we can get an initial draft by end of week that’d be ideal.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Kapoor

Subject: Re: Confirmation: No ML tuning on customer data — post-demo follow-up

Hi Sanjay / Elena —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Attached is the executed MAP (Signed-MAP-ORBIT-459.pdf) which includes the following commitments from Redwood:
- No training or model tuning on Orbit Health data at any time unless Orbit provides written opt-in.
- PII/PHI must be redacted prior to any processing beyond serving; Redwood will provide the technical redaction spec and a test harness on request.
- Logging & retention: request/response logs (application-level payloads) will be retained 30 days by default; operator and admin audit logs (access events, role-based actions) will be retained 365 days and can be exported on request.
- Audit artifacts: we will provide time-bounded access logs and a signed audit statement within three business days upon approved request; the Security-Controls-Summary.pdf describes the artifacts we can produce.
- Data residency: account will be pinned to us-west-2 as requested.

Next steps:
1) Orbit signs the MAP (attached).
2) Aditya will initiate DocuSign and confirm billing/account notes.
3) Dylan will run through the redaction spec with your engineering/security team next week and provide the test harness.

If anything in the MAP or the controls summary needs adjustment, flag now and we’ll amend prior to formal onboarding.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
